meta.name: perf-profiler
meta.description: Use when profiling CPU/memory hot paths, generating flame graphs, or capturing JFR/perf evidence.

copy.tagline: 分析CPU和内存热点，生成火焰图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位Java应用性能瓶颈
copy.tagline_en: Profile CPU and memory hot paths, generate flame graphs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate Java application performance bottlenecks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析 CPU 或内存的热点路径，生成火焰图或 JFR 性能证据，并输出热点位置和原因。
howto.when: 当你需要分析程序性能瓶颈，比如 CPU 占用高或内存热点时，可以要求 Claude 进行性能剖析。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 Java 程序的 CPU 热点。
say.note: Claude 会启动性能剖析工具并生成火焰图。

say.text: 找出这段代码的内存热点路径。
say.note: Claude 会定位内存占用高的代码位置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can profile CPU/memory hot paths, generate flame graphs or JFR evidence, and output hotspots with file:line and reason.
howto.when_en: When you need to analyze performance bottlenecks, such as high CPU usage or memory hotspots, you can ask Claude to perform profiling.

say_en.text: Profile the CPU hotspots of this Java program.
say_en.note: Claude will run profiling tools and generate a flame graph.

say_en.text: Find memory hot paths in this code.
say_en.note: Claude will locate memory-intensive code locations.
